description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040011678313 ARM,CHAIN SEAR: Line 0001 Qty 41 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0322 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
